name: Get editor localization settings
description: Call this when you need to know whether multi-language (localization) content is available for the current account's email/page editor, and how many languages it allows, before offering or building a translated variant of a template. It reports capability only — it does not read or write any template's language content, and it is not the action for account-wide plan or feature lookup, where the account info action is the better fit.
preconditions: The caller must be authenticated to the Brevo web app with a session that the editor API accepts.

featureEnabled.description: Whether the multi-language localization feature is available to this account.

maxLanguages.description: Maximum number of languages the account may use in a localized design; observed as 0 when the feature is disabled.

pricingVersion.description: Identifier of the pricing model the account is on, which gates the localization feature (observed value: "v5").
